seed_separation: search, validation and formal sets are disjoint

selection_metric.formula: mean over search seeds and 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% work checkpoints of log(stat_proxy)

validation_rule: ranked search candidates are rerun on validation seeds 500--504 before formal freeze
formal_rule: only the validation-confirmed frozen batch is used for formal seeds 0--19

common_settings.checkpoint_policy: nearest native checkpoint at or below target; no interpolation
